metadata.short_desc: Distinguish memes/stickers from photos, parse emojis, and guide LLM to respond socially.
metadata.desc: Intelligently distinguishes whether the user sent a meme/sticker or a normal photo/screenshot, guiding the LLM to respond like a real human instead of mechanically describing pixels. Features QQ emoji semantic translation and non-invasive prompt injection.

enable_sticker_sense.hint: When enabled, the plugin automatically detects stickers and memes, guiding LLMs to respond socially.

enable_face_translation.hint: Translates QQ native emojis (e.g. Doge, Smile) into semantic text for the LLM to understand.

prompt_style.hint: natural: friendly daily chat; humorous: witty meme banter; gentle: warm emotional empathy; roast: playful teasing and tsundere banter (strictly bounded by persona).

max_sticker_dimension.hint: Static images with width and height within this threshold will be treated as stickers if protocol metadata is absent.

auto_fill_empty_prompt.hint: Automatically fills empty prompts with semantic hints when users send only stickers or emojis.

enable_meme_reaction.hint: When enabled, prompts the LLM to actively engage in meme battles or reply with stickers when suitable.

custom_prompt_guide.hint: Optional custom instruction appended to the sticker interaction guide.
